svg.text: Janzen: at similar crossing height, the annual range of the lowland flank reaches the temperate crest but not the tropical one
Bars: annual range, coldest-month minimum to warmest-month maximum
Moisture: the Altiplano crest is far wetter than its Pacific flank; Táchira is humid throughout
Aridity index, P / PET (Global-AI v3.1; log scale)
Warming: the isotherm now at 2000 m rises 735 m; low crests open west–east and break the montane belt north–south, high crests do not
west–east crossing opens; montane belt breaks
